Lakeshore Summit 2027: sponsor prospectus

Gold package: a 3 by 3 meter booth, six full passes, a 20 minute session on the main stage, and a logo on the event website.
Every package includes lead retrieval for your booth team.
Gold and Platinum sponsors also receive the opted-in attendee list, emailed by the organizer two weeks before the show. Only attendees who agreed to share their details at registration are included.
Payment terms: 30 percent deposit on signing, balance 60 days before the event.
